items.title: SolarWinds Patches 15 Critical Serv-U Flaws That Could Hand Attackers Root Access
items.description: SolarWinds has released important security updates for its Serv-U file transfer software, addressing 15 vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to gain elevated privileges and, in some cases, execute code with root user access. The package, Newtonsoftt.Json.Net, copied the appearance of the widely used Newtonsoft.Json library while carrying code designed to alter game outcomes.
